label: Thin ice at the stream bank
source_prompt:
Paint a square, seamless material texture for a hand-painted fantasy game, in the same painterly style, brushwork and colours as the attached pictures.
- Seen straight on and flat, filling the whole picture edge to edge. No perspective.
- Seamless: the left edge must continue into the right edge, and the top edge into the bottom edge, so the square can repeat without a visible join.
- Even, flat light. No lamp glow, no bright patch, no vignette and no cast shadows. Only soft folds or grain.
- Only the material itself: no objects, no poles, no ropes, no ground and no sky.
- Even spread: nothing noticeably bigger, brighter or darker than the rest, because the square repeats many times.
- No text, no letters, no border and no signature.

Subject: the edge of a half-frozen stream, seen from above: a band of thin pale ice and white frost foam, with little round air bubbles and lacy edges, over dark blue-black water. About 1.5 m of bank edge across. The picture's top edge is the white ice against the bank and its bottom edge is the dark open water, so it can run along a stream bank. Night, cold blue moonlight, painted with even light.

Picture shape: wide (3:2).
final_prompt: Create ONE flat hand-painted fantasy game BORDER TEXTURE, WIDE 3:2 aspect ratio. Use the attached pictures for the painterly brushwork and cold nocturnal blue/lavender palette only. The asset is ONLY a transition from thin pale stream ice to dark open water. Strict orthographic TOP-DOWN view, no perspective. TOP 45 percent: continuous thin PALE SILVER-BLUE ICE, frosty white lacy patterns, a few small round trapped air bubbles, spread evenly. MIDDLE: irregular scalloped delicate lace edge of the ice, running horizontally LEFT TO RIGHT. BOTTOM 45 percent: dark blue-black open stream water with tiny subdued evenly spread ripples. The topmost canvas edge is ALL WHITE/PALE ICE and the bottommost edge is ALL DARK WATER. The left and right edges join for seamless horizontal repetition. Fill entire canvas. No land, no bank, no earth, no stones, no boulders, no vegetation, no grasses, no reeds, no trees, no snow-covered plants, no scenery. Do not include the physical bank from the references. Even flat soft lighting, no cast shadows, no glow, no text, no border.
